translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
. ( aey payghumber ! ) yaqeen jano , hum ney tumhen khuli hoi fatah ata kerdi hai ,
takay Allah tumhari agli pichli tamam kotahiyon ko moaaf kerday ,   aur takay apni naimat tum per mukammal kerday , aur tumhen seedhay raastay per ley chalay ,
aur ( takay ) Allah tumhari aesi madad keray jo sabb per ghalib aajaye .

wohi hai jiss ney emaan walon kay dilon mein sakeenat utaar di ,   takay unn kay emaan mein mazeed emaan ka izafa ho aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik

takay woh momin mardon aur aurton ko aesay baaghaat mein dakhil keray jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , jahan woh hamesha basay rahen gay , aur unn ki buraiyon ko unn say door kerday aur Allah kay nazdeek yeh bari zabardast kamiyabi hai

aur takay unn munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton aur mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey jo Allah kay sath bad-gumaniyan rakhtay hain . burai ka pher unhi per parra huwa hai ,   aur Allah unn say naraz hai , uss ney unn ko apni rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye jahannum tayyar ker rakhi hai , aur woh boht hi bura thikana hai .
aur aasmano aur zameen kay tamam lashkar Allah hi kay hain , aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen gawahi denay wala , khushkhabri denay wala aur khabrdar kernay wala bana ker bheja hai ,
takay ( aey logo ! ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur uss ki madad kero , aur uss ki taazeem kero , aur subha o shaam Allah ki tasbeeh kertay raho .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tum say beyat ker rahey hain woh dar-haqeeqat Allah say beyat ker-rahey hain .   Allah ka haath unn kay haathon per hai . uss kay baad jo koi ehad torray ga , uss kay ehad torrney ka wabal ussi per parray ga , aur jo koi uss ehad ko poora keray ga jo uss ney Allah say kiya hai , to Allah uss ko zabardast sawab ata keray ga .

woh dehaati jo ( hudaibia kay safar mein ) peechay reh gaye thay ,   abb woh tum say zaroor yeh kahen gay kay :  humaray maal o dolat aur humaray ehal o ayaal ney hamen mashghool kerliya tha , iss liye humaray liye maghfirat ki dua ker-dijiye .  woh apni zabanon say woh baaten kehtay hain jo unn kay dilon mein nahi hoten . ( unn say ) kaho kay :  acha to agar Allah tumhen koi nuqsan phonchana chahye ya faeeda phonchana chahye to kon hai jo Allah kay samney tumharay moamlay mein kuch bhi kernay ki taqat rakhta ho-?   balkay jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tum ney yeh samjha tha kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) aur doosray musalman kabhi apney ghar walon kay paas loat ker nahi ayen gay ,   aur yehi baat tumharay dilon ko achi maloom hoti thi , aur tum ney buray buray gumaan kiye thay , aur tum aesay log ban gaye thay jinhen barbad hona tha .
aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan naa laye , to ( woh yaad rakhay kay ) hum ney kafiron kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ker rakhi hai .
aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tamam tarr Allah hi ki hai , woh jiss ko chahye , bakhsh dey , aur jiss ko chahye , azab dey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

. ( musalmano ! ) jab tum ghaneemat kay maal lenay kay liye chalo gay to yeh ( hudaibia kay safar say ) peechay rehney walay tum say kahen gay kay :  hamen bhi apney sath chalney do .    woh chahen gay kay Allah ki baat ko badal den .   tum keh dena kay :  tum hergiz humaray sath nahi chalo gay . Allah ney pehlay say yun hi farma rakha hai .    iss per woh kahen gay kay :  darasal aap log hum say hasad rakhtay hain .    nahi ! balkay haqeeqat yeh hai kay yeh log khud hi aesay hain kay boht kam baat samajhtay hain .

inn peechay rehney walay dehaatiyon say keh dena kay :  unqareeb tumhen aesay logon  kay paas ( larrney kay liye ) bulaya jaye ga jo baray sakht jangjoo hon gay , kay ya to unn say larrtay raho , ya woh itaat qubool kerlen .   uss waqt agar tum ( jihad kay uss hukum ki ) itaat kero gay to Allah tumhen acha ajar dey ga , aur agar tum mun morro gay jaisa kay tum ney pehlay mun morra tha to Allah tumhen dardnak azab dey ga .

andhay aadmi per ( jihad naa kernay ka ) koi gunah nahi hai , naa langray aadmi per koi gunah hai , aur naa beemar aadmi per gunah hai . aur jo shaks bhi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ka kehna maaney , Allah uss ko aesi jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi . aur jo koi mun morray ga , ussay dardnak azab dey ga .

yaqeenan Allah unn mominon say bara khush huwa jab woh darkht kay neechay tum say beyat ker rahey thay , aur unn kay dilon mein jo kuch tha woh bhi Allah ko maloom tha ,   iss liye uss ney unn per sakeenat utaar di , aur unn ko inaam mein aik qareebi fatah ata farma di ,
aur ghaneemat mein milney walay boht say maal bhi jo unn kay haath ayen gay ! aur Allah iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

Allah ney tum say boht say maal-e-ghaneemat ka wada ker rakha hai jo tum hasil kero gay ,   abb fori tor per uss ney tumhen yeh fatah dey di hai , aur logon  kay haathon ko tum say rok diya ,   takay yeh mominon kay liye aik nishani ban jaye , aur tumhen Allah seedhay raastay per daal dey ,
aur aik fatah aur bhi hai jo abhi tumharay qaboo mein nahi aai , lekin Allah ney uss ko apney ehatay mein ley rakha hai ,   aur Allah her cheez per poori tarah qadir hai .
aur yeh kafir log tum say larrtay to yaqeenan peeth pher ker bhag jatay , phir enhen koi yaar o madadgaar bhi naa milta ,
jaisa kay Allah ka yehi dastoor hai jo pehlay say chala aata hai , aur tum Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz tabdeeli nahi pao gay .

aur wohi Allah hai jiss ney makkah ki wadi mein unn kay haathon ko tum tak phonchney say , aur tumharay haathon ko unn tak phonchney say rok diya , jabkay woh tumhen unn per qaboo dey chuka tha ,   aur jo kuch tum ker rahey thay Allah ussay dekh raha tha .

yehi log to hain jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya , aur tumhen masjid-e-haram say roka , aur qurbani kay janweron ko jo thehray huye kharray thay , apni jagah phonchney say rok diya .   aur agar kuch musalman mard aur musalman aurten ( makkah mein ) naa hoten jinn kay baaray mein tumhen khabar bhi naa hoti kay tum unhen pees daalo gay , aur uss ki wajeh say bey khabri mein tum ko nuqsan phonch jata   ( to hum inn kafiron say tumhari sulah kay bajaye jang kerwa detay , lekin hum ney jang ko iss liye roka ) takay Allah jiss ko chahye , apni rehmat mein dakhil kerday .   ( albatta ) agar woh musalman wahan say hatt jatay to hum inn ( ehal-e-makkah ) mein say jo kafir thay , unhen dardnak saza detay .

. ( chunacheh ) jab inn kafiron ney apney dilon mein uss hamiyat ko jagah di jo jahiliyat ki hamiyat thi to Allah ney apni taraf say apney payghumber aur musalmanon per sakeenat nazil farmaee ,   aur unn ko taqwa ki baat per jamaye rakha ,   aur woh issi kay ziyada haq daar aur iss kay ehal thay , aur Allah her cheez ko khoob janney wala hai .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah ney apney Rasool ko sacha khuwab dikhaya hai jo waqaey kay bilkul mutabiq hai . tum log inn sha Allah zaroor masjid-e-haram mein iss tarah aman o aman kay sath dakhil hogay kay tum ( mein say kuch ) ney apney saron ko bey khof o khatar mundwaya hoga , aur ( kuch ney ) baal tarashney hon gay .   Allah woh baaten janta hai jo tumhen maloom nahi hain . chunacheh uss ney woh khuwab poora honey say pehlay aik qareebi fatah tey kerdi hai .
wohi hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sacha deen dey ker bheja hai , takay ussay her doosray deen per ghalib kerday . aur ( uss ki ) gawahi denay kay liye Allah kafi hai .

Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) Allah kay Rasool hain ,   aur jo log unn kay sath hain , woh kafiron kay muqablay mein sakht hain , ( aur ) aapas mein aik doosray kay liye reham dil hain . tum unhen dekho gay kay kabhi rukoo mein hain , kabhi sajday mein , ( gharz ) Allah kay fazal aur khushnoodi ki talash mein lagay huye hain . unn ki alamaten sajday kay asar say unn kay chehron per numaya hain . yeh hain unn kay woh osaaf jo toraat mein mazkoor hain .   aur injeel mein unn ki misal yeh hai kay jaisay aik kheti ho jiss ney apni konpal nikali , phir uss ko mazboot kiya , phir woh moti hogaee , phir woh apney taney per iss tarah seedhi kharri hogaee kay kaashtkaar uss say khush hotay hain ,   takay Allah unn ( ki iss taraqqi ) say kafiron ka dil jalaye . yeh log jo emaan laye hain , aur enhon ney naik amal kiye hain , Allah ney inn say maghfirat aur zabardast sawab ka wada kerliya hai .
